scope: Post-H0.0 canonical planning coordinator refreshed to current main registry generation 70. Preserve verified H0.0 as history and prepare a fresh-current-main C22 child Work Order only after actual checkpoint merge, post-merge audit and Director dispatch.
required_outputs: Fresh H0.1 planning epoch on current canonical registry generation 70
Fresh current-main C22 branch after dispatch
stop_conditions: Runtime/domain change attempted under this planning Work Order
C22 branch creation before Director dispatch
risk_reasons: H0.1 is the first controlled runtime-development pilot.
Incorrect handoff could authorize stale-main runtime work.
Recovery and exact-head evidence are checkpoint-critical.

design_brief.problem_statement: H0.0 R3 is verified terminal evidence and current main advanced to registry generation 70 through advisory ECO synchronization. The checkpoint candidate must be refreshed without rewriting H0.0 evidence or opening runtime.
design_brief.current_behavior: Canonical main is 82835a37 / registry 70. Earlier H0.1 planning attempts are not active and launcher must not select them.
design_brief.desired_behavior: Status/Plan/Resume select H0.1-R4 on current main generation 70, report H0.1 as next, keep runtime workers zero while PLANNED, then require post-merge audit and Director dispatch before C22 branch creation.
alternatives_considered: Refresh the canonicalization branch and create a fresh planning epoch
design_brief.selected_design: Refresh from current main, create H0.1-R4 with exact main 82835a37 and registry 70, preserve strict identity, preserve H0.0 history and keep branch creation dispatch-gated.
design_brief.why_selected: It makes the checkpoint candidate current-main compatible and remains fail-closed if main moves again.
non_goals: No main-owned registry mutation in this planning Work Order
expected_risks: Launcher selects an obsolete H0.1 attempt
validation_plan: Require Plan H0.1 with zero runtime workers and FORBIDDEN_UNTIL_DISPATCH
After merge audit new main before dispatch

notes: Planning coordinator only. If main moves again before checkpoint integration, stop and refresh rather than silently continuing across a registry mismatch.
